svg.font-family: "Helvetica Neue","Segoe UI","Liberation Sans",Arial,sans-serif,"Hiragino Sans","Noto Sans JP","Yu Gothic","Meiryo","IPAPGothic",sans-serif
svg.title: A coffered dome seen from below
svg.desc: 5 rings of 28 equal coffers, each recessed in 3 steps, shrink toward an open oculus at the top of the page. The sectors are equal by construction and encode no data.
